suggestedEdits.report: Hepatitis B virus-related acute-on-chronic liver failure (HBV-ACLF) is associated with a high mortality rate. Although mesenchymal stem cell (MSC) therapy markedly improves liver function and survival in patients with HBV-ACLF, it remains unclear whether the intervention works.
